Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 55, "heading": "V\nLE RETRAIT OÙ DIT SES HEURES MONSIEUR LOUIS DE FRANCE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u055-b0254", "target": "Чулочник, несмотря на знаки, которые ему подавал Гильом Рим, казалось, был намерен дать отпор королю.", "source_sha256": "23cab5387837ff0e6d05cb68c4ed58c2187c2f76e97ba174a4dd02650b28e7ca", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u055-b0254", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "78677b1561b8914b1576bf72ca7507deceb03a5decdf6da009974496c4ecc68f"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u055-b0255", "target": "«Государь, швейцарцы тоже были мужичьём. Господин герцог Бургундский был великим дворянином и плевал на эту сволочь. В битве при Грансоне, Государь, он кричал: Пушкари! огонь по этим мужикам! — и клялся святым Георгием. Но авойе Шарнахталь бросился на прекрасного герцога со своей палицей и со своим народом, и от встречи с крестьянами в буйволовых шкурах блистательное бургундское войско разлетелось, как оконное стекло от удара камня. Там много рыцарей было убито мужланами; и господина де Шато-Гийона, величайшего сеньора Бургундии, нашли мёртвым вместе с его большим серым конём на маленьком болотистом лужке.»", "source_sha256": "f847159376765f38d6192942daf49e81513128c28f9b98fee98306b64178819a", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u055-b0255", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5e2bb4e044d2c643f596feef219e8d1afb7e1e5d5768845dfc27bb2a4422725e"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 10, "chapter": 5, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u055-b0256", "text": "—L'ami, repartit le roi, vous parlez d'une bataille. Il s'agit d'une mutinerie. Et j'en viendrai à bout quand il me plaira de froncer le sourcil.»", "sha256": "7e647f0e835d7e01ba01e41c6d41f3c2ea5585c718438e0063014959c2b2b159", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3554], "source_xml_sha256": "25499c7833ee293bae22ebff6243dd0d840aae546fb72f24f236d0676e6de668", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0257", "text": "L'autre répliqua avec indifférence:", "sha256": "4ede0a2c6dcb96e6cd3c1715acedc6cdd864352b469c11ee62e9aa930dbb92bf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3555], "source_xml_sha256": "b1992f0f24abc76310329c371d0b14d0190bffabf953948ebeeb590e34e75645", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0258", "text": "«Cela se peut, Sire. En ce cas, c'est que l'heure du peuple n'est pas venue.»", "sha256": "b39b0bcdfcbeed0e42e219aa2ac57bd6dffa2cf2417a25779862a1333deb09b9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3556], "source_xml_sha256": "44684610778ae664934a90a9ee7db1bb2804bd437e4ce6a070d81662d5e44ff6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0259", "text": "Guillaume Rym crut devoir intervenir.", "sha256": "aea58bd78c58c2c80eae29daa019b86cf54413293c5ce454b8ad19a7309a2fd3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3557], "source_xml_sha256": "5a3240fcc0c6ad7c14959d106cc8c6f941a8bda156616374ac8c23895c8775f8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0260", "text": "«Maître Coppenole, vous parlez à un puissant roi.", "sha256": "83894f9ebaea5dbe3fabad7bcc19a980a997064f4899d6359f1d93416d6c430f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3558], "source_xml_sha256": "d27afaa46c8782fed5c8254aa8084884d253da59292377a45691f3cc60f65dbc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0261", "text": "—Je le sais, répondit gravement le chaussetier.", "sha256": "d43c648e254f2c1b60457677e9634b9f90ad4dd828c4b31aa605b8b57f2cf91c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3559], "source_xml_sha256": "0f628e3be692b8be5c50b021ca8a486c75a7f140675c60eac4d5572b369a80eb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0262", "text": "—Laissez-le dire, monsieur Rym mon ami, dit le roi, j'aime ce franc-parler. Mon père Charles septième disait que la vérité était malade. Je croyais, moi, qu'elle était morte, et qu'elle n'avait point trouvé de confesseur. Maître Coppenole me détrompe.»", "sha256": "804a5fbc1f0075c5824df3ec07f6f68af7d0b405141b9957b15427895bfe3c71", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3560], "source_xml_sha256": "abd5e3ea772001d9d3ad22908c5404903591925cb621f5985836951a37a0d0b6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0263", "text": "Alors, posant familièrement sa main sur l'épaule de Coppenole:", "sha256": "caa1516d9588022f8525ddf7fdd35f6a37c5c1fcdf5824c3fd35c2d8fa40578d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3561], "source_xml_sha256": "5686907f23f73e53bad0263d59edd3ae95572f054d408b73596307ee950fe63b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0264", "text": "«Vous disiez donc, maître Jacques?...", "sha256": "51a14d1d69bdaad6c39616e65cb861607f6b5f29d7f61ccccf08b4c65ee1425a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3562], "source_xml_sha256": "db9cfb9b3de8a584756de4af38c94e3face0ce952b67881ed67a998079213364", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0265", "text": "—Je dis, Sire, que vous avez peut-être raison, que l'heure du peuple n'est pas venue chez vous.»", "sha256": "53f682cb483f84d0c04085e5cc72d9679c56a66960acac6655ce0937ca556d1e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3563], "source_xml_sha256": "74a51225e3c88393ed5cb80e0a5a0576a6f7c8a58821e123678c675a76602644", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0266", "text": "Louis XI le regarda avec son œil pénétrant.", "sha256": "559b71f2e564c309e4efc407c948694bb51c06cc26d8dc400514c3b15407456c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3564], "source_xml_sha256": "40aed833d9f1c3a9eaca98744653f67ea5e5f914f76805bcdfc2b4df15420343", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0267", "text": "«Et quand viendra cette heure, maître?", "sha256": "457788db908769a2b56853014b38f88ae774b5975d1d8b396f99bf3df4af3d3d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3565], "source_xml_sha256": "f332e0f7b2fcb685194833edef471226d91ff293beaa152ac9dd1e5ef93241fe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0268", "text": "—Vous l'entendrez sonner.", "sha256": "70357686a0ef5ad3b56d66038390a4d2fcf6cfdc5a15b7d3ba14e60fb7cd27fa", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3566], "source_xml_sha256": "3b5982d30bf8b8fd821917adbb2dec58b130f1f29f547e9c30046f6258bc105e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0269", "text": "—À quelle horloge, s'il vous plaît?»", "sha256": "08fb05c3ff7b9ce5ac1f717e55fd3885b74a8703c97631f0fa33b127665b4b5b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3567], "source_xml_sha256": "2393ec3c2c3904631b9a6f9a3ebabd304f5f760666fedef6598e3fb4214c8292", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0270", "text": "Coppenole avec sa contenance tranquille et rustique fit approcher le roi de la fenêtre.", "sha256": "3528c2e1b1b4bb94cb3bff2126213bdbab2cea040f0037969ec7605c69564fcf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3568], "source_xml_sha256": "1739f6c13eefe20e1ccef6382c88c0d5c151713899fa628bce7bb2f7ca879f39", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0271", "text": "«Écoutez, Sire! Il y a ici un donjon, un beffroi, des canons, des bourgeois, des soldats. Quand le beffroi bourdonnera, quand les canons gronderont, quand le donjon croulera à grand bruit, quand bourgeois et soldats hurleront et s'entre-tueront, c'est l'heure qui sonnera.»", "sha256": "df682d25fa1bcaa7e478093a5da9053904113f339c1ebe513ae3e9567dcec5ca", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3569], "source_xml_sha256": "d0811feb1734d2fd65ecbb08bb4067d33689ce5b1937c627e0185445454d61ac", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0272", "text": "Le visage de Louis devint sombre et rêveur. Il resta un moment silencieux, puis il frappa doucement de la main, comme on flatte une croupe de destrier, l'épaisse muraille du donjon. «Oh! que non! dit-il. N'est-ce pas que tu ne crouleras pas si aisément, ma bonne Bastille?»", "sha256": "3d047274035ccf78ed1beef062f51ee4467e3fd2f111ca878054683309f7663d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3570], "source_xml_sha256": "3d16306721e6d5734bf8cf4570e5e9673e167e760eb8377b40ffc25230af9203", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0273", "text": "Et se tournant d'un geste brusque vers le hardi flamand:", "sha256": "04de2ad7f525f27e3312e308a5d1f5d02dde7637ab88b60169a16e959a374ebf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3571], "source_xml_sha256": "b1eb3fc1bc3480d648101795875f7e8ad158cdb6b030fa24f776eba798b4b738", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0274", "text": "«Avez-vous jamais vu une révolte, maître Jacques?", "sha256": "0311988231a4b98ab93def02258ac68755e11b54409aa9f547136908cd08bed0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3572], "source_xml_sha256": "9a43b5a5218da2d8d2c308da892be59f14a281cc7ad58929ea4eb9094b22a39a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0275", "text": "—J'en ai fait, dit le chaussetier.", "sha256": "63680b51f3cbf22321f2f31d4693c2e114230f79787b09c6c7ce8b71451999c3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3573], "source_xml_sha256": "ee8d493fc82f4a6da74fd0b51dd1af1aa9eecc7e72e2902c19307443c83ac564", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0276", "text": "—Comment faites-vous, dit le roi, pour faire une révolte?", "sha256": "d0c9aebe331a2572e1c602351680e6b5234232c44812a4bd7e74dd5b64959401", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3574], "source_xml_sha256": "e1e491a57029f474bdde93d3131e8dc13b2033d28c40b2f7793a87418f206af5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0277", "text": "—Ah! répondit Coppenole, ce n'est pas bien difficile. Il y a cent façons. D'abord il faut qu'on soit mécontent dans la ville. La chose n'est pas rare. Et puis le caractère des habitants. Ceux de Gand sont commodes à la révolte. Ils aiment toujours le fils du prince, le prince jamais. Eh bien! un matin, je suppose, on entre dans ma boutique, on me dit: Père Coppenole, il y a ceci, il y a cela, la demoiselle de Flandre veut sauver ses ministres, le grand bailli double le tru de l'esgrin, ou autre chose. Ce qu'on veut. Moi, je laisse là l'ouvrage, je sors de ma chausseterie, et je vais dans la rue, et je crie: À sac! Il y a bien toujours là quelque futaille défoncée. Je monte dessus, et je dis tout haut les premières paroles venues, ce que j'ai sur le cœur; et quand on est du peuple, Sire, on a toujours quelque chose sur le cœur. Alors on s'attroupe, on crie, on sonne le tocsin, on arme les manants du désarmement des soldats, les gens du marché s'y joignent, et l'on va! Et ce sera toujours ainsi, tant qu'il y aura des seigneurs dans les seigneuries, des bourgeois dans les bourgs, et des paysans dans les pays.", "sha256": "498d15b4b6a15a53e23cbea54e28d01f0066b0549a3a4b53dbd2bd355fdf9c4a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3575], "source_xml_sha256": "caa515b8e8d7375fba1376ac5fc4012dd93fd821616dfcf5c1a4262d01cfd9a2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0278", "text": "—Et contre qui vous rebellez-vous ainsi? demanda le roi. Contre vos baillis? contre vos seigneurs?", "sha256": "849c05a4c63f6b2636c01d2efe331e9ea1dbcfc5051a683fce94a5056a15afed", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3576], "source_xml_sha256": "68729420f6bcf7f970c02b65fcaf23155c7170a976ab3a238dcc3bc0a07c8ddc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0279", "text": "—Quelquefois. C'est selon. Contre le duc aussi, quelquefois.»", "sha256": "1b38b72c3ca81d7acc21fb57bfc8543cd053e899002d90b98c5d2f9e0e456cc6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3577], "source_xml_sha256": "ce5b8d8acee0ee724aa33a9a22c665352a29251752aec79680f72f9130473fd9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0280", "text": "Louis XI alla se rasseoir, et dit avec un sourire:", "sha256": "52aab8565c49a855afd80a7acb7bfd2bae6e7776dc593f00470dac7c7dc9512a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3578], "source_xml_sha256": "2c3c83ea7e23ada264c4144e4759a5e2213036cbad4e56ebeb6144ce7e6743aa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0281", "text": "«Ah! ici, ils n'en sont encore qu'aux baillis!»", "sha256": "caa257c49773591fd2cd0ba8d5fd984c441ec89438525d6a975d8ddada01f30e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3579], "source_xml_sha256": "b409dd8f2233d5a8f5ef08876e01b5bcb93b4721aa7a63e4d7eb9e27cb0dcd8a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0282", "text": "En cet instant Olivier le Daim rentra. Il était suivi de deux pages qui portaient les toilettes du roi; mais ce qui frappa Louis XI, c'est qu'il était en outre accompagné du prévôt de Paris et du chevalier du guet, lesquels paraissaient consternés. Le rancuneux barbier avait aussi l'air consterné, mais content en dessous. C'est lui qui prit la parole:", "sha256": "0de94a2e467bde25ae117561f98872a6b9e090bf1c2f2132be13e0eab43ec649", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3580], "source_xml_sha256": "dfc9182ceb6ff7af281cee0b276e5301d17ce6ed27c39455361517a3c594213a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0283", "text": "«Sire, je demande pardon à Votre Majesté de la calamiteuse nouvelle que je lui apporte.»", "sha256": "24851d961f76d5e20a366014c87d51a7eb705fed83950d39046f918dba28fc51", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3581], "source_xml_sha256": "076fe1b20ec525c0aae67d63ca4f198d68789606b6cb6081ebd5f7a736e5a0c6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u055-b0284", "text": "Le roi en se tournant vivement écorcha la natte du plancher avec les pieds de sa chaise:", "sha256":
